title: AI-assisted Lean Riemann Hypothesis proof alleged vacuous
summary: A social-media report alleges that a claimed AI-assisted Lean formalization of the Riemann Hypothesis and a generalized version was vacuous: key definitions were written as tautologies and geometric conditions were effectively empty. The report says Alpöge and Claude released only 17 million lines of Lean across 175,000 files, with no human-readable proof, and that Lean and Mathlib community members said the next day they had "sufficient confidence" the code proved the proposition. It further says Alpöge later conceded that "250,000 pages is a joke" and that the code was "full of garbage but compiles," calling the criticism entirely reasonable. These claims are unverified and no technical artifacts were supplied, so the status of any proof remains unresolved.
